name: Silent Symphony of Ice Skating Stars
description: In a frozen sky, stars glide like skaters on ice, leaving trails of sparkling fragments, creating a silent yet luminous ballet.
prompt: A night sky where stars appear as luminous beings skating on an invisible ice rink, leaving trails of glittering shards, surrounding a snowy landscape, surreal, ethereal lighting, high detail
caption: Watch the cosmos perform a silent ballet—stars glide, twirl, and leave whispers of starlight behind. ✨❄️ #IceSkatingStars #SilentSymphony #CelestialDance
